title: Garro Leads Libertadores Assists and Earns Praise from Diniz
seoTitle: Garro Leads Libertadores Assists, Praised by Diniz
subtitle: The Argentine stands out in Corinthians' midfield and helps in the quarterfinal stage
excerpt: Rodrigo Garro took the lead in Copa Libertadores assists, providing the decisive pass for Kaio César in the draw against Estudiantes.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
Rodrigo Garro took the lead in Copa Libertadores assists, providing the decisive pass for Kaio César in Corinthians' draw against Estudiantes in La Plata. Head coach Fernando Diniz praised the player's work, highlighting his offensive and defensive contributions.

Garro Leads Assists in the Libertadores

Alongside Matías Fernández, the Argentine was responsible for the pass that resulted in Kaio César's goal, securing the lead in the continental competition's assist rankings. Since the start of the Libertadores, Garro has provided assists for goals by Yuri Alberto and Kayke, as well as Gustavo Henrique in matches against Santa Fe and Peñarol, totaling 12 assists this season and 4 in the tournament.

Diniz Highlights Garro's Work

The coach emphasized that Garro's work has been “very positive” since his arrival at the club. He mentioned that, despite having “fluctuated” in some matches, his performance in games like the one against Red Bull was excellent. Diniz also highlighted the player's defensive work, which “contributed to us having a solid defensive system.”

Corinthians' Goal Involvements in the Libertadores

In the goal involvement rankings, Garro appears as Corinthians' second-best player, with 4 assists in 8 matches. Gustavo Henrique leads the group with 4 goal involvements, including 3 goals and 1 assist. Other names in the Top 5 include Memphis Depay, Zakaria Labyad, and Kayke, each with 1 goal involvement.

Impact on Corinthians' Performance

The midfielder has been involved in 50% of all Corinthians' goals in the continental tournament. His role in creating opportunities and maintaining defensive structure has been deemed crucial for the team, according to Diniz, who expects Garro to continue producing assists at a high level.

Outlook for the Final Stage

With his lead in assists and defensive support, Garro has been one of Corinthians' pillars in the quarterfinal stage. The coach hopes the player's dedication will continue to drive the team in pursuit of the “Eternal Glory” of the Libertadores.
